pr-local.evidencePolicy: Captured terminal panes and smoke-results.json from this checkout

setup.boot: npm run test:golden:navigator starts the installed Pi binary with this checkout's extensions in a private tmux server
setup.authBypass: PI_OFFLINE=1 and a placeholder API key; no model requests are sent
setup.seed: The journey seeds session-scoped synthetic task/subagent registry entries and logs, then removes them on exit
setup.fixtures: scripts/navigator-detail.tui.e2e.test.mjs owns the session, fixtures, keyboard actions, and terminal captures

paths.observable: Exit 0 with no skipped tests: real Pi opens subagent and background-task details, renders the actual transcript and complete CJK log at 100 and 80 columns, retains exactly one input frame, and accepts editor input after closing detail. Captured panes and smoke-results.json are saved to PI_NAVIGATOR_EVIDENCE_DIR (a printed temporary directory by default).
